title: "Four stages, eight steps"
format:
  html:
    mermaid-format: svg

{{< include ../_includes/workflow-diagram.qmd >}}

Steps run in sequence, and the order is load-bearing. The recommended order
comes from the R recipes package's
[Ordering vignette](https://recipes.tidymodels.org/articles/Ordering.html):
8 positions, grouping into 4 stages. Each position has its own page, with the
shoez steps that fill it today:

| # | Position | shoez steps |
|---|---|---|
| **Stage 1 · Handle missing values** | | |
| 1 | [Missing: impute](../four-stages/missing-impute.qmd) | `StepImputeMean`, `StepImputeMedian`, `StepImputeMode` |
| 2 | [Missing: category levels](../four-stages/missing-category-levels.qmd) | `StepUnknown` |
| **Stage 2 · Wrangle** | | |
| 3 | [Wrangle: transforms](../four-stages/wrangle-transforms.qmd) | *planned* |
| 4 | [Wrangle: discretize](../four-stages/wrangle-discretize.qmd) | *none; rarely advisable* |
| 5 | [Wrangle: dummy variables](../four-stages/wrangle-dummy-variables.qmd) | `StepDummy`, `StepOneHot` |
| **Stage 3 · Model prep** | | |
| 6 | [Model prep: interactions](../four-stages/model-prep-interactions.qmd) | `StepPolynomial` |
| 7 | [Model prep: normalize](../four-stages/model-prep-normalize.qmd) | `StepNormalize` |
| **Stage 4 · Multivariate transforms** | | |
| 8 | [Multivariate transforms](../four-stages/multivariate-transforms.qmd) | `StepPca`, `StepClassDistance` |

Each stage exists so the next one works: handle missing first — impute the
numeric gaps and give missing categorical levels an explicit value — because
every later step wants complete columns, and the guard levels must exist
before the dummy step freezes its vocabulary; wrangle everything into numbers
next; model prep after, so interactions can cross indicator columns with
numerics
and normalize catches the freshly created columns; multivariate transforms
last, because they want the finished, scaled matrix.

The ordering is deliberately silent on the filter steps (`StepDropZeroVariance`,
`StepDropCorr`) — [dropping columns](dropping-columns.qmd) is not a stage. In
practice filters run as two passes: after stage 1, to drop dead or redundant
raw columns before effort is spent encoding and scaling them, and again after
the dummy step, where a rare level can produce an all-zero indicator column.
